meta.disclaimer: Health information disclaimer. AQI forecasts on this site are produced by a statistical model and can be wrong. The health messages are general guidance based on the Central Pollution Control Board's National Air Quality Index and the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare's air-pollution advisories, with cautions from the World Health Organization. They are not medical advice and do not replace advice from your doctor. If you have a health condition, follow the plan your doctor has given you. Seek medical help promptly if you experience breathlessness, chest pain, dizziness or other worsening symptoms. In an emergency, call 112.
